| # | Area | Commit | Competitor Gap Closed |
|---|------|--------|-----------------------|
| 1 | **Pipeline/CRM** | `b50c570` | Task progress badges on kanban cards + working mobile list view (vs JobNimbus) |
| 2 | **Reports** | `d6b3fb7` | Comparison periods with trend arrows ↑↓ and delta % badges (vs JobNimbus — whose "Insights is AWFUL") |
| 3 | **Work Orders** | `528f7eb` | Editable line items with add/remove/totals (vs RoofLink's full production workflow) |
| 4 | **Dashboard** | `eb05317` | Monthly revenue goal progress bar with on-track/behind indicator (vs JobNimbus goals) |
| 5 | **Leads** | `d740774` | Saved filter presets — bookmark combos for reuse (vs JobNimbus named filter lists) |

All changes use existing patterns (oklch colors, glass cards, localStorage for zero DB cost, form-input class). All build checks pass.
